segments.ja366:2.1: Madhu iti maññamānā [madhūti maññamānāya (ka.)], ye taṃ visamakhādisuṃ [visamasāyisuṃ (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja366:2.3: Tesaṃ taṃ kaṭukaṃ āsi, maraṇaṃ tenupāgamuṃ.
segments.ja366:3.1: Ye ca kho paṭisaṅkhāya, visaṃ taṃ parivajjayuṃ;
segments.ja366:5.3: Ye sadā parivajjenti, saṅgaṃ loke upaccagunti.
